ruleDefinitions.name: Chromium Browser Headless Execution To Mockbin Like Site
ruleDefinitions.description: Detects the execution of a Chromium based browser process with the "headless" flag and a URL pointing to the mockbin.org service (which can be used to exfiltrate data).

sequences.query: ((process_path = RGX("\\\\brave\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\chrome\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\msedge\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\opera\\\.exe$") OR process_path = RGX("\\\\vivaldi\\\.exe$")) AND process_command_line = RGX(".*\\-\\-headless.*") AND (process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/run\\\.mocky.*") OR process_command_line = RGX(".*\\:\\/\\/mockbin.*")))
